_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/plan/runplan.pin.json (plan §9 / ADR-0033). runplan.jsonl lists concrete runs; this pin freezes the preregistered run classes so diagnostic/attribution runs can never enter the main winner selection and A5/A1-C/A5-C stay conditional. run_ids must match config/campaigns/pes2ts_v542_backbone_50k.yaml run_matrix exactly. T3 is split: top2 (A1-A4 only, max 4 runs) + a5_supplement (A5 only, max 2 runs, parent gate a5_full_dose_complete_and_seed17_screen_pass). gate-0 A5 2026-10-30 (P3 lane D): this pin is the t1_start_requires record requirement runplan_pin_record (instance verified by the runner at the WP5 runplan freeze; record SHA = sha256 of canonical file bytes). gate-3 B2/C2 2026-10-30 (P3 remediation lane R2) clarification: runplan_pin_record is verified by the WP5 RUNNER at the runplan freeze — the WP0 schema validator --formal gate records the requirement only and NEVER reads the pin instance; only a0_reuse_decision_record and preregistration_signoff_record are validator-checked at --formal (config mirror + record_sha256 canonical digest).

nominal.description: T0 matched A0 retrain x3 (baseline, winner_eligible=false per run row, role=matched_baseline_retrain) — T0 A0x3 formal + V542-A0-sanity-band PASS MUST complete before any T1 formal run — + T1 A1-A4 seed17 full dose (400+37,500) after diagnostic/cost gates
nominal.counts_toward_winner_note: winner eligibility is judged PER RUN via the run row's winner_eligible flag; the nominal class flag is NOT a blanket winner-counting claim (A0 rows are winner_eligible=false)

conditional.description: T2 A5 seed17 full dose (only when no A1-A4 H3-qualified candidate after top2 seeds; launch_requires diagnostic/cost/H0/H1); T3 top-2 preregistered A1-A4 x {29,43} — only the frozen inner-val top-2 (max 2x2=4 runs) activates under the seed17_screen_pass predicate; A5 T3 rows are a SEPARATE a5_supplement branch (max 2 runs) gated by a5_full_dose_complete_and_seed17_screen_pass
launch_requires: T0 A0x3 formal + V542-A0-sanity-band pass BEFORE any T1 formal

top2_preregistration.eligibility: A1-A4 only, must satisfy seed17_screen_pass predicate, ranked by frozen screen score, max 2 candidates, may be fewer, NO substitution
top2_preregistration.freeze_requires: A0_S17 complete + A0x3 sanity band pass (V542-A0-sanity-band; A0x3 seed-mean vs V541 E0x3 seed-mean within band)

a5_supplement.note: seed17 SCREEN predicate, NOT a three-seed H3 claim; A5 full-dose run complete AND seed17_screen_pass

diagnostic.description: Unconditional 2,000-update engineering screens (V542_DIAG_A0_S17 matched-dose reference + V542_DIAG_A1-A5_S17) and attribution controls A1-C/A5-C; never enters winner competition; diagnostic metrics never carry full-dose H3 effect gates

skip_rules.V542_A1C_S17: gate_skipped(a1_not_in_top2_and_not_selected) — 归因未解决写明, 不加入 C2
skip_rules.V542_A5C_S17: gate_skipped(a5_not_selected_backbone) — A5-C activates only when A5 is SELECTED as Backbone*; if A5 is H3-qualified but not selected, record capacity_caveat_unresolved and do NOT run

core_training_count_formula: N_core = 3 + n_T1_seed17(<=4) + I(A5_full_dose) + n_diag2000(=6) + 2*n_top2_selected(<=2 candidates) + 2*I(A5_supplement) + I(A1C_activated) + I(A5C_activated). This counts NEW TRAINING runs only; smoke/profile are technical measurements and do NOT enter N_core. top2 max = 4 runs (2 A1-A4 candidates x seeds 29/43); a5_supplement max = 2 runs; combined T3 ceiling = 6. N_core is always computed from the formula, NEVER by summing listed run rows.

wp4_diagnostic_disposition._note: WP4 diagnostic ruling 2026-10-30 (Oracle; ADR-0033 v1.3.3; protocol_amendment_id V542_WP4_DIAG_20261030): effective dispositions of the completed seed17 diagnostic 2,000 screens. The candidate learning screen applies only to screen_subjects [A1,A2,A3,A4,A5]; A0 is the matched same-dose control; A4's frozen-rule elimination (3.849742% < 5.0%) is binding. thresholds/budget values and the 26 run_ids are unchanged; the immutable v1 diagnostic_report.jsonl is superseded append-only by diagnostic_report.v2.jsonl.

diagnostic_control.note: A0@2000 is the matched-dose control, never a candidate screen subject; T0 A0x3 formal rows stay mandatory with NO diagnostic_gate; A0 validity failures (non-finite/H0/H1/resource) are invalid_run, not eliminated

diagnostic_gate_skipped.t3_status: gate_skipped unactivated (cannot satisfy activated_only_by_inner_val_top2 without the seed-17 full-dose / seed17_screen_pass evidence; same diagnostic reason)
diagnostic_gate_skipped.note: A4 loss drop 3.849742% < 5.0% frozen threshold is binding — V542_A4_S17 full dose is NOT run; no replacement candidate or extra seed is backfilled

statistics_contract.p_value_rule: one-sided improvement paired cluster bootstrap: p = (1 + #{seed-averaged paired bootstrap improvement <= 0}) / (10001); CI and p share the same draws; frame-level forbidden
statistics_contract.holm_families: MOVE direction exit alpha=0.025 Holm over eligible candidates; MOVE RMSE exit alpha=0.025 Holm over eligible candidates; PROCESS single family alpha=0.025 Holm over 2 endpoints x eligible candidates
statistics_contract.h3_eligible: winner-eligible candidates with all three seeds complete and no per-seed H2 breach (A5 only when three-seed complete); diagnostic variants excluded
statistics_contract.route_logic_ref: evaluation_contract.route_logic — MOVE pass = (direction_pass AND rmse_non_inferior) OR (rmse_pass AND direction_non_inferior); PROCESS pass = (auprc_pass AND q_non_inferior) OR (q_pass AND auprc_non_inferior); seed17 screen reuses the same parenthesized logic

final_selection_rule.eligible: H3-qualified candidates only (three seeds complete, per-seed H2 clean, adjusted p < corresponding alpha with effect/non-inferiority conditions)
final_selection_rule.single_candidate_rule: exactly 1 H3-qualified candidate => that candidate is Backbone*

shared_protocol.batch: 8 curves x 4 frames stratified start/pre-TS/post-TS/endpoint; (seed, update, salt) sampler protocol

code_commit_note: optional record only (git_commit_authoritative=false); NOT part of the T1 block rule
_t1_block_rule: runplan_sha256 AND source_manifest_sha256 must be non-null before formal T1 (formal-run SHA freeze); code_commit is optional because git_commit_authoritative=false
